comparison.objective: Install and correctly tighten a spin-on oil filter; candidate separates ceramic finishing media from steel washers.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1405 tests coaxial threaded engagement, gasket contact, sustained rotation/regrasping, and controlled final tightening, with versions using either prescribed hand rotation or an 18 N·m wrench endpoint. Candidate tests bimanual screen handling, agitation, selective passage, and reseating.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1405 grades thread engagement, alignment, gasket seating, and a bounded final rotation/torque so the filter is neither loose nor over-tightened. Candidate grades recovery fraction, washer retention, passage history, spill/damage, support contact, release clearance, and dwell.
comparison.reason: Thread starting and torque-controlled fastening are meaningfully different from separating mixed rigid bodies through a perforated screen.
